property.name: git.commit.message.full
property.value:
fix(workspace): hide archived workspace metadata without deleting history (#1066)
Apply the existing non-archived workspace lifecycle to the metadata visibility query. Preserve the archive response, underlying row and branch provenance.
Add four real Spring MVC/JPA regressions for the archive transition, owners, admins and historical shared rows. Before the fix all four returned 200 instead of 404. The focused access suites pass 18 cases; the combined modular layout with #1065 and the interop correction passes 73 focused cases.
Full verification remains a separate CI gate; local attempts encountered an invalid X11 environment and then the 4 GiB runtime memory limit.
